items.title: Earl May interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 11, 2001
items.q: But we had Herman Foster and Russell Elefante... The four of us. The trio and her. And we were very close

ctx.x: This was late 50s, right after Billy Taylor. I stayed with Billy from ’51 to about late ’59, and then I started with Gloria right after that, late ’59 into the 60s, up to about ’64 maybe. I’m sorry it didn’t last longer than that but it wasn’t my fault. But we had Herman Foster and Russell Elefante. And the compliments we got was that it actually was like if you saw one you would see the other three of us. The four of us. The trio and her. And we were very close, very, very — like I say you wouldn’t see one…
Oh yeah. She became quite the pop—
